move: cursor presses pill button, emoji squashes then elastic pops with particle burst
how: A dark pill button holds an emoji, a label and a counter, with a pink radial glow behind. A cursor flies in with power3.out over the first 22% of the 4s loop and the button lifts 4% on hover. At 1.1s (28%) the press: cursor, button and emoji all shrink with power2.in over 0.12s (emoji to 0.7 with -12deg rotation). Release at 1.24s (31%): button springs to 1.06 with elastic.out(1,0.4), emoji overshoots to 1.55 and +14deg with elastic.out(1.2,0.35) then eases back with back.out(2), a pink ring scales 0.9 to 1.35 fading out, the counter rolls 128 to 129 with yPercent ±110 power3.inOut, the glow swells, and 14 heart/star glyphs fly upward on seeded random arcs fading over about a second. Cursor exits at 2.6s, button relaxes, and the counter rolls back to 128 in the last 10% so the loop closes.
adapt: Change the emoji, the label, the two counter values, the accent pink and the glyph list; particle count 14 is a tunable. Keep the press-at-28% / release-at-31% timing and the elastic eases — that is the tactile pop.
port: mount(el, shot) creates glow, button (ring, emoji, label, counter c1/c2, burst container with 14 particles seeded by fx.rng) and the cursor svg. animate builds the same timeline with times scaled as fractions of D (press at 0.275D, release at 0.31D, exit at 0.65D, counter reset at 0.9D) and returns it. All '.cursor', '.btn' etc. selectors must be scoped to el; the cursor start offsets (300,260) assume a centred stage.
caveats: counter rollback in the last 0.4s is visible as a reset rather than a natural loop
glow opacity tweened to 1.5 relies on clamping
